test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) JN-IK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a859acba1ddd7cbc40dd215dfa65ee820a619d0f3a57dab2bd27aaacc89cea24.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f653a7d684376514c6d50cd3f787f34360444c3d5f84a0fb6e48efd6cddf75d9.png] 

Option 2) DH-CF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f2d6041be894668c7290d951388303738fe013092c7af39f15054cd4fc47085.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe5e770daad9896c502737cff91d2fe436fd751cca45d84e0865bf76e028d7c8.png] 

Option 3) GK-FI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9272c68dba1e70b2a671649a4ff4e84e16df56921d3e9db815b563df6c779f1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f3b98dac922542f1e53f9f9b49d7eca2235d24edb3c14ce2dd611bb1689f3fe.png] 

​Option 4) QU-PS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebb1a9b93950f50f9871cccb194f743850fce367ca6e7b10b7e4715e0800e82c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c50e0108a48df93bd9fc35da797f118746c65663ed2c32334376798933303ebe.png] 

Thus, out of all 'JN-IK' is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
